signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.caption: Build the skills to create memorable visitor experiences.
signIn.verified: Your email is verified. Sign in to continue.
signIn.invalid: Email or password is incorrect. Check them and try again, or reset your password.
signIn.description: Sign in to your account. Trainer and admin access come from the account itself.

locked: This account is locked. Contact Academy support.

learner.title: Welcome back
learner.description: Sign in to continue your learning journey.
learner.alt: A family on a dhow with the Museum of Islamic Art behind them

trainer.title: Trainer sign in
trainer.description: Open your trainer workspace: sessions, attendance, scoring and marking.
trainer.alt: A hotel meeting room set up for training
trainer.note: Trainer access comes from an account provided by the Academy. Choosing this mode does not grant trainer access.

admin.title: Academy admin sign in
admin.description: Open the Academy Dashboard, AI Analytics, Reports and Academy Management.
admin.alt: West Bay skyline in Doha at dusk
admin.note: Administrator access comes from a pre-provisioned account. Choosing this mode does not grant administrator access.

afterSignIn: You signed in with a {{role}} account, so we opened the {{role}} area. The sign-in mode never changes access.

validation.fictionalEmail: Use a fictional address ending in example.com
validation.name: Enter your full name
validation.code: Enter the six-digit code from the demo inbox.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Registration is open to everyone and creates a learner account.
register.noteA: You are joining Program A: Tourism Service Professional. After you verify your email you will confirm your enrolment.
register.noteB: New accounts start with Program B: Visitor Service Essentials, a personalised, self-paced programme.
register.noteC: Program C is an illustrative sample. New accounts start with Program B: Visitor Service Essentials.
register.altA: A family walking at the National Museum of Qatar
register.altB: Towers beside a turquoise lagoon in Doha
register.caption: Explore flexible learning, practise real situations and progress through a journey shaped around your role.
register.name: Full name
register.emailHint: Use a fictional address ending in example.com for this demonstration.
register.next: Next you will verify your email in a simulated step and complete a short profile. Your profile helps us recommend relevant learning.
register.failed: Registration failed. Check your connection and try again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we will create a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link has been generated by the demo mail service.
forgot.demoNote: Demo accounts use fictional example.com addresses, so no real inbox receives the link.
forgot.demoShown: The demo link is shown below.
forgot.error: We could not send the request. Try again in a few minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.invalid: This reset link is not valid or has expired.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.intro: This demonstration does not send real email. Your verification code is shown in the demo inbox below.
verify.signInAfter: Your email is verified. Sign in with your email and password to continue.
verify.noCode: A new code could not be issued. If you already verified, sign in instead.

sso.heading: Or use connected sign-in
sso.note: Optional connected sign-in for CRM and internal tools.
sso.tourismAccount: Amira Al Ansari, fictional learner L0013
sso.tourismDetail: In production this would hand you to a Qatar Tourism identity provider and link your CRM record.
sso.organisationAccount: Rania Al Thani, fictional learner L0016 at Demo Corniche Residences
sso.organisationDetail: In production this would hand you to your employer’s identity provider and match your organisation.
sso.description: This demonstration does not connect to a real identity provider. Nothing is authenticated by Qatar Tourism or your organisation. {{detail}} The actual provider, claims, account linking and CRM APIs must be confirmed later.
sso.mockAccount: Mock account used in demo mode
sso.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
sso.unavailable: The mock account is not available right now. Use email and password instead.

demo.title: Demo accounts
